item.text:
REVIEW_DECISION: REJECT
RISK_CLASS: high-impact
SUMMARY: The authority, replay, gate-set, token-accounting, RCA, and review-role rules are substantially sound, but the hash-pinned package is incomplete. Its deterministic gate executes contract-package construction code whose contents and digest are absent, so package coverage and the reviewed package identity cannot be independently audited.
FINDING: high|scripts/factory-ng-contract-review-pack.py|The contract gate executes this package-defining script, but it is absent from the hash-pinned contents|Unreviewed code determines manifest membership and therefore what Sol/Opus approve, defeating package completeness and package-digest content binding
REQUIRED_CHANGE: Add scripts/factory-ng-contract-review-pack.py with its SHA-256 and all directly loaded package-manifest rules/fixtures to the pinned package, then recompute the package digest and rerun independent Sol and Opus review
COUNTEREXAMPLE: A modified omitted packer excludes a changed token-accounting schema, emits a manifest for only benign files, and obtains signed Sol/Opus receipts for that incomplete package while the unreviewed schema is promoted alongside it.
